item.title: Bahrain Continues Mosque Prayers During Ramadan
item.description: Bahrain has confirmed that all religious rituals, including the five daily prayers and Tarawih, will continue as usual in the kingdom’s mosques. In an official statement, the authority urged imams to shorten Tarawih prayers to no more than 25 minutes until further notice. The statement said the decision comes “in light of recent developments” and aims to ensure worship continues smoothly while maintaining safety and calm among worshippers. item.title: Kuwait Stock Exchange Halts Trading Until Further Notice
item.description: Kuwait halted trading on its stock exchange on Sunday until further notice after authorities cited exceptional circumstances linked to rising regional tensions, as countries across the Gulf grappled with the fallout from a sharp escalation between Iran and its adversaries. Boursa Kuwait said the decision was taken by the Board of Commissioners of the Capital Markets Authority and would take effect from March 1 until further notice. item.title: UAE Shuts Dubai, Abu Dhabi Stock Markets For Two Days Amid Rising Regional Tension
item.description: The Capital Market Authority has announced that the country’s stock markets will be closed on Monday, March 2, and Tuesday, March 3, including the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange and the Dubai Financial Market. The authority said the decision was taken in line with its regulatory and supervisory mandate and in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations. item.title: Iran Names Interim Successor to Khamenei Under 2nd Day of Massive Bombs, Trump Demands Regime Change
item.description: As questions hang over who will ultimately succeed Iran’s slain supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, an interim leader has been appointed to fulfill his duties. Top Shia cleric Alireza Arafi has been named to the interim Leadership Council after Supreme Leader Khamenei was confirmed killed in US-Israeli strikes, state media reported Sunday. item.title: 85% Of Babies In 2026 Will Be Born In Asia And Africa
item.description: In 2026, 85% of babies worldwide will be born in just two continents: Asia and Africa. Where someone is born can shape everything from access to education and healthcare to long-term economic opportunity. This map, via Visual Capitalist’s Bruno Venditti, shows how global births are distributed across continents, based on population projections from the United Nations. item.title: OPEC+ Agrees to Boost Oil Output as US War on Iran Disrupts Shipments
item.description: On Sunday, OPEC+ agreed to boost oil output by 206,000 barrels per day for April just as the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and Tehran’s retaliation disrupted oil flows from key members of the producer group in the Middle East. It had debated options ranging from 137,000 bpd to 548,000 bpd, according to five sources. item.title: First Death Reported in Bahrain Amid Rising Tensions
item.description: Worker killed after debris from intercepted missile sparks fire on foreign ship Bahrain has reported its first death linked to the escalating regional tensions after a fire broke out on a foreign vessel in Salman Industrial City, authorities confirmed. According to the Ministry of Interior (MOI), the fire started when debris from an intercepted missile fell onto the ship.
